tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Everything sits on it unless it has a reason not to.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells that recede: table headers, code, the query editor. Not for hover.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, menu items, quiet and secondary buttons. A highlight, lighter than raised in dark. Not for wells, and never the surface of a chart.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: The fill of an untoned control while it is pressed or busy: default and quiet buttons, segments, menu rows, legend rows, sortable heads, a key link's cell. Darker than hover (light) and lighter than hover (dark) by enough to see, and distinct from rule, which marks what is chosen. Ink and ink-secondary only on it; never ink-muted. A press lasts as long as the finger: a series swatch on a pressed row is carried by its own ground ring (series reach 2.7:1 on pressed, 3:1 on every other surface).

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Overlays only: menus, popovers, dialogs. Always with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate regions and rows, and the fill of what is chosen (a segment, a legend row, a diff's insertion). Series colours reach 3:1 on it. Decorative as a line: carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: rule-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on ground, sunken and raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and data on ground, sunken and raised.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on ground, sunken and raised: descriptions, legends, axis labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata and placeholders on ground, sunken and raised. The lightest text that still passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Deliberately below contrast; never for content.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog, over the page it blocks. The only translucent colour. Nothing is read through it: the page under it is inert.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The primary action: one per view. Same value in both themes. Never used for selection or status.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a blue button.

tokens.name: blue-pressed
tokens.usage: Fill of a blue button while it is pressed, so a press is visible even when the pointer was already over it.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on blue and blue-hover.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Destructive actions. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: red-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a red button.

tokens.name: red-pressed
tokens.usage: Fill of a red button while it is pressed, so a press is visible even when the pointer was already over it.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on red and red-hover.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Affirming actions (resolve, acknowledge).

tokens.name: green-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a green button.

tokens.name: green-pressed
tokens.usage: Fill of a green button while it is pressed, so a press is visible even when the pointer was already over it.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on green and green-hover.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Cautionary actions (silence, snooze). Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: yellow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a yellow button.

tokens.name: yellow-pressed
tokens.usage: Fill of a yellow button while it is pressed, so a press is visible even when the pointer was already over it.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on yellow and yellow-hover.

tokens.name: yellow-edge
tokens.usage: Border of a yellow button, so its edge reaches 3:1 on light surfaces. Equal to the fill in dark.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Critical status mark: a solid square. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Warning status mark: a solid diamond. On light surfaces it is drawn with a status-warn-edge outline.

tokens.name: status-warn-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of the warning mark, so it reaches 3:1 on light surfaces. Equal to the fill in dark.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy status mark: a hollow square.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational status mark: a short bar. A cyan that cannot be taken for the blue of the primary action.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (blue, the darker step). Slots are handed out in this order as series first appear in a view and then stay with the series for the life of the view (Chart rules). Odd slots are the darker step and even slots the lighter, so neighbours differ by at least 1.3:1 in luminance; slots 1 to 4 are drawn solid and pass the colour-vision validator as all pairs.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (copper, lighter step).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (berry, darker step).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (violet, lighter step).

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (umber, darker step). Slots 5 to 8 are drawn dashed (space-2 dash, space-1 gap): they repeat the lightness steps of 1 to 4, so the dash is what tells a slot 5 to 8 line from a slot 1 to 4 line under colour blindness. 5 to 8 pass the validator as all pairs among themselves.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (azure, lighter step, dashed).

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Chart series 7 (plum, darker step, dashed).

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Chart series 8 (teal, lighter step, dashed). Every series past the eighth folds into Other.

tokens.name: series-other
tokens.usage: Everything past the eighth series, drawn as ONE entry: the edges of the Other band (its fill is sunken), its legend swatch, a switched-off swatch's outline, and every line that steps back while another is emphasised. Neutral, at least 3:1 on ground, sunken, raised, hover, rule and pressed, and set between the two lightness steps of the slots (at least 1.3:1 from every slot in light, 1.15:1 in dark, where a grey lighter than the light step would make Other's edges brighter than the lines), so in greyscale the band's edge is not read as a slot's line (v5 review, m5).

families.sans: "Schibsted Grotesk", "Schibsted Grotesk Fallback", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the name of the thing being looked at.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Requests that took longer than 500 ms, by route.
styles.usage: Prose: descriptions, reports, documentation. Measure 60 to 72 characters.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The default for interface text: controls, menus, panel titles, table cells with words.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, selected items, panel titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column heads and field labels. Sentence case, weight 500, in ink-secondary. Not capitals, not tracked.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every number a person compares, and every identifier they copy: values, timestamps, trace ids.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: The one value in a row that answers the question.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Keyboard hints and chart axis text. The smallest text in the system.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Optical nudges only: icon to label baseline, gap between stacked chart fills.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a control: icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the page gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels; the page gutter on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a page title; around an empty state.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, panels, anything that tiles edge to edge.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Marks inside a control: checkboxes, status squares, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, fields, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Overlays: menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The only shadow. On raised surfaces, to say that something floats above the page.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of controls inside dense toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of any control when the pointer is coarse (touch).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Table row and menu item height.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Every icon. One size.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running prose.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Status marks and legend swatches.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and border.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: The focus ring, chart lines, the progress bar, the selected tab's underline.

tokens.name: overlay-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of a menu.

tokens.name: dialog
tokens.usage: Width of a dialog.

tokens.name: plot
tokens.usage: Height of a chart plot in a dashboard panel.

tokens.name: plot-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a chart plot beside a form or inside a list (backtest, claim evidence).

tokens.name: label-gutter
tokens.usage: Width reserved at the right of a plot for direct series labels.

tokens.name: axis
tokens.usage: Width reserved at the left of a plot for value-axis ticks.

tokens.name: keep
tokens.usage: Width of each column a folded table keeps beside its key, never narrower than its longest phrase. Two of them leave the key half the row (key-min); a table keeps at most two.

tokens.name: key-min
tokens.usage: The least a folded table gives its key: half the row, so a name stays readable and its whole cell a target beside the kept columns. Below breakpoint-narrow, with two kept columns, the key takes the whole first line instead.

tokens.name: key-max
tokens.usage: Most a key-value list gives its names before the values take the rest.

tokens.name: diagonal
tokens.usage: The one angle: the warning diamond, the checkbox and menu ticks, the ruled-out slash.

tokens.name: breakpoint-narrow
tokens.usage: Below this width of its container a dashboard is one column, a fold table folds, a chart drops direct labels and its legend drops Min and Max, a diff stacks, a split page is one column. Media and container conditions cannot read custom properties, so the CSS writes 639px and check.mjs verifies every condition against these two tokens.

tokens.name: breakpoint-wide
tokens.usage: From this width a dashboard has twelve columns (six below). A table marked data-fold="wide" folds below it.

tokens.name: qty-scale
tokens.usage: A number in a sentence (vz-qty) is set at this fraction of the sentence's size, and never below data size, so mono figures match the sans optically in ui, body, heading and the page state line.

tokens.name: clamp-lines
tokens.usage: Most lines a log message shows before it is cut, with a button for the rest: enough for a message and the first frame of a stack trace, few enough that one line cannot push the others off a phone screen.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: An opacity change that needs one. Since v8 no component uses it: hover is drawn in the next frame and no colour is eased.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Things that enter or leave: menus, dialogs, the progress bar's growth.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The easing curve of everything that moves, except a measured progress bar (ease-measured).

tokens.name: ease-measured
tokens.usage: A progress bar moving between two measured values: at constant speed, because an eased bar shows an acceleration nobody measured. The only other curve; nothing else uses it.
